source.description: A reviewed six-panel raster contact sheet showing one consistent vintage rotary telephone progressing from pale graphite construction to a finished graphite and restrained burgundy, brass, and charcoal colored-pencil sketch.
source.notes: Keep one front-facing three-quarter desk telephone with one curved handset, two end caps, two cradle forks, one sloped base, one rotary dial with exactly ten finger holes, one center dial plate without text, one coiled cord with exactly two clear loops and one loose connecting curve, small hardware, and one broken shadow. No numbers, letters, logo, extra prop, or final-only detail is allowed.

process_strategy: Reserve the handset and coiled-cord footprints over one sloped base before drawing the dial, then add all ten finger holes and cradle hardware to the same geometry before shading so no late detail changes the silhouette or overlap order.

final_elements.name: base, handset, dial, cord, and shadow guides
final_elements.description: One pale sloped three-quarter base box, a curved handset envelope with two end-cap ellipses, two cradle positions, one centered dial circle, a coiled-cord route with two loop reserves and one loose connecting curve, and one broken shadow footprint.

final_elements.name: complete rotary telephone silhouette
final_elements.description: The curved handset with two end caps, two cradle forks, sloped desk base, raised dial housing, rear ledge, and one coiled cord following the reserved route.

final_elements.name: ten-hole rotary dial and center plate
final_elements.description: One circular rotary dial with exactly ten evenly spaced finger holes, an inner ring, one blank center plate, and one small finger stop.

final_elements.name: handset seams, base hardware, cord loops, and shadow
final_elements.description: Mouthpiece and earpiece seam rings, cradle joints, base-panel seams, two small screws, exactly two clear cord loops, one loose connecting curve, and one broken graphite cast shadow.

final_elements.name: graphite modeling and restrained telephone color
final_elements.description: Soft graphite planes, muted burgundy pencil on the handset and base, muted brass on the dial ring and small hardware, charcoal cord and deep accents, and preserved paper highlights.

allowed_changes: small overlap clarifications within existing guides

rejection_checks: The same base perspective, handset curve, dial position, cord route, crop, and scale must persist through all six panels.

Exactly ten dial holes, two handset end caps, two cradle forks, two clear cord loops and one loose connecting curve, all hardware, color areas, paper highlights, and the broken shadow must appear before the final panel and persist through the finish.
No numbers, letters, brand mark, logo, extra telephone, desk props, wall, room scene, decorative background, or final-only motif may appear.
No adjacent frame may look unchanged at card size, and the finish must remain a believable 25-30 minute handmade sketch rather than glossy product illustration.
